slides.say: Use memo versus use callback. They're closer than you think.

slides.text: useMemo caches the RESULT of a function.
slides.say: Use memo calls your function and caches the result. Here, the total is only recalculated when items change.
Use callback caches the function itself, so child components get the same function between renders.

slides.text: useCallback(fn, deps) is just useMemo(() => fn, deps).
slides.say: Fun fact: use callback is just use memo that returns a function. Reach for either only when you have a real performance problem.
